metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.1 · 2018 · The Princess Switch
metas.description: Competing in a Christmas baking competition in Belgravia, a Chicago baker bumps into the prince's fiancée--who looks just like her. They switch lives for two days.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 5.5 · 2020 · The Princess Switch: Switched Again
metas.description: When Duchess Margaret unexpectedly inherits the throne to Montenaro and hits a rough patch with Kevin, it's up to her double Stacy to save the day before a new lookalike, party girl Fiona foils their plans.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 5.6 · 2021 · The Princess Switch 3
metas.description: When a priceless relic is stolen, Queen Margaret and Princess Stacy enlist the help of Margaret's cousin Fiona teams with a man from her past to retrieve it, with romance and resulting in a very unexpected switch.
